scope: PART 2 ONLY, ss 8 to 14: illegal terms, termination, the four-band notice table, termination without notice and payment in lieu, contractual age, deemed breach by either party, dismissal after due inquiry, and who counts as a relevant employee for a wrongful-dismissal claim. The Act has 16 Parts and about 275,000 characters; Parts 3 (salary), 4 (rest days and hours), 9 (maternity) and 10 (leave) are each at least as useful to an employee and NONE is encoded. Within Part 2, ss 15-19 are not encoded.
